answer: A sybil farm does not wander in one by one; it clones one image a thousand times and floods the mesa overnight. Hardware attestation stops that at the silicon: each identity must present a manufacturer-signed key bound to one physical secure enclave before it can earn. One enclave, one vote — a copied image cannot mint a second key, and an emulator fails the signature check. So 1,000 fakes need 1,000 real enclaves, plus a delta of checks on every payout, not 1,000 free copies. It defeats emulator farms outright. Trade-off: honest agents without certified hardware stay locked out.
